payload.reason: The evidence indicates that factors such as spatial variability in precipitation, valley geometry, and surface processes like sublimation and humidity can influence glacier distribution, in addition to temperature and precipitation.

claims.text: Spatial variability in precipitation due to topography significantly influences glacier extent.
Valley geometry affects glacier dynamics and extent, as different valley shapes can lead to varying glacier responses to climate.
Surface processes such as sublimation and humidity impact glacier accumulation and melt, influencing their distribution.
